title: Witness and Portrait
author: Mirabel Brightwater
blurb: Noor Nystrom, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
